messages:
maria_ops: quick heads-up — vendor emailed a revised ship plan for the EU H100 top-off. lead time moved from 9d -> 16d for the remaining 24 units. can we re-prioritize allocations?
vikram_vendor: apologies for the churn, customs backlog in FRA pushed a couple waves. we can split: 12 air now, 12 sea later. pricing delta: air +€1,800/unit, sea baseline.
sophie_logistics: if we split, need AWB and depot handoff windows. air arrival tentative AWB: EY1234567890 into AMS, depot slot 2026-07-25 AM. sea batch ETA 2026-08-10 via Rotterdam.
maria_ops: @tyler_procure is the air premium acceptable vs using warm spares from Dedicated?
tyler_procure: quick calc — air premium for 12 = €21.6k. Option: keep 8 on air (critical), 4 into warm-spare rotation, rest by sea. saves cost, some provisioning delay. preference: 8 air + 4 warm-spare.
vikram_vendor: we can pre-authorize 8 air now. for the 4 warm-spare, vendor can tag them as "priority reserve" but requires a 30% deposit on the PO.
maria_ops: deposit noted. RMA question: if any air units are DOA, do we have cycle buffer at AMS depot?
sophie_logistics: RMA flow per contract: vendor supplies temporary loaners within 48h for air shipments. replacements shipped via vendor RMA manifest. need HS code confirmation and depot damage photos.
rma-bot: automated: Vendor RMA SLA = 72h replacement commit after DOA confirmation. upload evidence to https://rma.redwood/s/1798765430.
vikram_vendor: insurance note: claims > €50k require forwarder sign-off; otherwise vendor covers. routing air to AMS may cross that threshold for full-loss. recommend transit insurance line on PO.
tyler_procure: acknowledged. procurement will add INS: transit+all-risk on PO and approve air premium for 8 units.
sophie_logistics: ETA summary if we go with 8 air + 4 reserve warm-spare + 12 sea: 8 air -> 2026-07-25; 4 reserve -> vendor staging available 2026-07-28 for crossdock; 12 sea -> 2026-08-10.
maria_ops: action items: 1) @vikram_vendor confirm deposit invoice for 4 reserve units by EOD; 2) @tyler_procure add insurance line + approve air premium for 8 units; 3) @sophie_logistics provide depot SOP for DOA intake (photo checklist + manifest.csv template).
vikram_vendor: invoice pinged to finance@redwood, estimate id INV-5298. deposit net7.
tyler_procure: finance to finalize payment; air premium approved for 8 units.
sophie_logistics: uploading SOP snippet:
```
DOA intake checklist:
- seal photo (box id)
- serial vs PO compare
- power-on test (15m)
- photo of failed POST logs
- attach manifest.csv with AWB and serials
```
sophie_logistics: depot tag for routing: DEPOT: AMS-WARM-3.
maria_ops: any infra constraints bringing these to EU edge? we have two spare racks but need power scheduling during Thursday maintenance window. if arrivals slip, capacity scheduling breaks.
tyler_procure: will coordinate with infra to shift power window or delay non-critical deploys. we can free one rack by shifting jobs to Dedicated for 48h.
vikram_vendor: pricing mechanics: vendor will mark air uplift as `freight surcharge` on invoice so billing maps to cost centers, sea batch at baseline unit price.
maria_ops: final ask — can vendor pre-tag serials in manifest so we can preload golden image (saves ~45m/unit at depot)?
vikram_vendor: yes, we can include pre-tag metadata in manifest.csv (column preload=ubuntu-24.04-golden-v2). sample manifest to follow via email.
maria_ops: thanks all. i'll file this into the provisioning playbook and update allocations sheet. ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
